title.zh: 将奎松市 Pasong Putik 描笼涯划分为三个彼此独立的描笼涯的法案
title.en: An Act Dividing Barangay Pasong Putik in Quezon City Into Three (3) Distinct and Independent Barangays to Be Known as Barangay Pasong Putik Proper, Barangay Greater Lagro and Barangay North Fairview
title.orig: An Act Dividing Barangay Pasong Putik in Quezon City Into Three (3) Distinct and Independent Barangays to Be Known as Barangay Pasong Putik Proper, Barangay Greater Lagro and Barangay North Fairview

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 8 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2022/ra_11803_2022.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Division of Barangay Pasong Putik. - Barangay Pasong Putik in Quezon City is hereby divided into three (3) distinct and independent barangays to be known as Barangay Pasong Putik Proper, Barangay Greater Lagro and Barangay North Fairview.

Conduct and Supervision of Plebiscite. - The plebiscite conducted and supervised by the Commission on Elections (COMELEC) pursuant to Quezon City Ordinancce No. 439, series of 1996 of the Sangguniang Panlungsod of Quezon City, which ratified the creation of Barangays Pasong Putik Proper, Barangay Greater Lagro and Barangay North Fairview as proclaimed by the Plebiscite Board of Canvassers on December 8, 1996 shall serve as substantial compliance with the plebiscite requirement under Section 10 of Republic Act No. 7160, otherwise known as the Local Government Code of 1991, as amended.

Incumbent Barangay Officials. - The incumbent barangay officials of Barangay Pasong Putik Proper, Greater Lagro and North Fairview shall continue to hold office until such time that their successors have been duly elected and qualified.

Public Infrastructure and Facilities. - All public infrastructure and facilities for public use existing therein at the time of the approval of this Act shall continue to be owned and administered by the barangays herein created under Section 1 of this Act.

National Tax Allotment Shares. - Barangays Pasong Putik Proper, Greater Lagro and North Fairview shall be entitled to an allotment derived from national taxes pursuant to Section 285 of Republic Act No. 7160, otherwise known as the Local Government Code of 1991, as amended.
Repealing Clause. - All laws, decrees, executive orders, rules and regulations contrary to or inconsistent with any provision of this Act are hereby repealed or amended accordingly.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
